release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.44.1-canary.1 is a licensing-authority validation build. It includes the new stateful license authority client adapter, automatic first-device slot claims, signed short-lived entitlements, protected local entitlement storage, remote validation and deactivation, clear device-limit/revocation errors, and the existing protected 14-day offline license lease. It also includes responsive Classic navigation hardening and the deterministic Setup Wizard/Chromium regression fixes required by the release gates. This Canary is intended only for live desktop validation against the hosted Tachyon authority before any Stable cutover. Stable remains unchanged.
